labels: Relevance labels and calibration/test split are fixed in the versioned dataset before scoring either candidate.
specialized_embedding_candidate_policy: Test only a dedicated local embedding model already installed and compatible with the existing embedding endpoint. Do not download models for this experiment.

no_answer_gate_on_held_out_test.definition: Fraction of test queries with no relevant document for which the operational candidate inserts any retrieved skill context into the prompt.

ranking.uncertainty: Report 95% Wilson intervals for binary query-level rates and 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples for model differences, seeded with 13013. Small sample intervals are descriptive and do not establish population performance.

open_set_threshold_experiment.purpose: Diagnostic only unless the selected threshold also passes held-out quality gates and is explicitly wired and verified in the live pipeline.
open_set_threshold_experiment.selection: Maximize balanced accuracy for answerable versus no-answer classification on calibration queries; on ties choose the largest threshold. Never select the threshold from test outcomes.

operational_experiment_budgets.qualification: These are predeclared local experiment budgets for the available workstation, not an existing PsicoIA product SLO, clinical requirement, or production SLA. Report measured conditions and sample counts; for the three-turn integration, apply the 180-second limit per observed turn rather than claiming a statistical p95.

selection_rule: A candidate is operationally selectable only if the unmodified live generation flow completes with it, held-out ranking and no-answer gates pass in both locales, measured local budgets pass, and persistence/restart/failure-recovery checks pass. Prefer the less operationally complex candidate when evidence is tied. Preserve the Block 12 Phi embedding configuration if no alternative satisfies every gate.
